title: The beautiful revolution
description: British elegance, American optimism, and a new generation of European sports cars.

cars.name: Jaguar E-Type Series 1 3.8 Coupé
cars.description: The E-Type arrived at Geneva in 1961 with a long bonnet, flowing bodywork and the character of Jaguar’s racing cars. Its 3.8-litre XK six-cylinder engine helped make it a defining British sports car. The fixed-head coupé pairs those famous curves with a practical opening rear hatch.

cost.basis: Indicative UK range for a good to excellent early 3.8-litre fixed-head coupé. Outside-bonnet-lock, competition and exceptional-provenance examples are separate markets.

cars.name: Aston Martin DB5
cars.description: The DB5 combined elegant grand-touring bodywork with a four-litre straight-six engine. Introduced in 1963, it became a lasting symbol of British motoring, helped by its appearance in Goldfinger. Beneath the film-star reputation is a refined touring car built for covering long distances in style.

cost.basis: Indicative UK market range for good to excellent standard examples; condition, originality and provenance affect value.

cars.name: Ford Mustang 289 Coupé
cars.description: Unveiled to the public in April 1964, the Mustang brought long-bonnet, short-deck styling to a broad audience. A choice of engines and equipment let buyers make it their own. This 1965 hardtop represents the classic 289 V8 version of the car that helped define the pony-car era.

cost.basis: Indicative UK range for a good to excellent standard 289 V8 hardtop coupé; excludes Shelby, K-code, fastback and convertible premiums.

cars.name: Porsche 911 2.0 Coupé
cars.description: The original 911 carried Porsche’s sports-car ideas into a new generation. Its rear-mounted two-litre flat-six engine, compact proportions and distinctive roofline established a template that would evolve for decades. This early short-wheelbase coupé captures the simplicity and character of the first production cars.

cost.basis: Indicative UK market range for good to excellent standard examples; condition, originality and provenance affect value.

cars.name: Lamborghini Miura P400
cars.description: First shown in 1966, the Miura brought a transverse V12 mounted behind the occupants into a breathtakingly low sports-car shape. Its sweeping bodywork and dramatic proportions made the P400 a landmark of Italian design. It helped establish the mid-engined layout as the image of the modern supercar.

cost.basis: Indicative UK range for a good to excellent original P400; later S, SV and special-provenance cars are separate markets.
